content.text: 输入包含三份CSV和一份法典PDF，输出目录为空；下一步核对字段、编码、行数及关键法条原文。

input.command:
python - <<'PY'
import csv, pathlib
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('/app/input_files').glob('*.csv')):
    for enc in ('utf-8-sig','latin-1'):
        try:
            with p.open(encoding=enc,newline='') as f:
                r=csv.reader(f); h=next(r); rows=list(r)
            print(p.name, enc, 'rows',len(rows),'cols',len(h),'header',h)
            break
        except UnicodeDecodeError: pass
PY

RCW 18.27.010   Definitions.   The definitions in this section 
apply throughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires 
otherwise.
(1)(a) "Contractor" includes any person, firm, corporation, or 
other entity who or which, in the pursuit of an independent business 
undertakes to, or offers to undertake, or submits a bid to, construct, 
alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, develop, move, wreck, 
or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other 
structure, project, development, or improvement attached to real 
estate or to do any part thereof including the installation of 
carpeting or other floor covering, the erection of scaffolding or 
other structures or works in connection therewith, the installation or 
repair of roofing or siding, performing tree removal services, or 
cabinet or similar installation; or, who, to do similar work upon his 
or her own property, employs members of more than one trade upon a 
single job or project or under a single building permit except as 
otherwise provided in this chapter.
(b) "Contractor" also includes a consultant acting as a general 
contractor.
(c) "Contractor" also includes any person, firm, corporation, or 
other entity covered by this subsection (1), whether or not registered 
as required under this chapter or who are otherwise required to be 
registered or licensed by law, who offer to sell their property 
without occupying or using the structures, projects, developments, or 
improvements for more than one year from the date the structure, 
project, development, or improvement was substantially completed or 
abandoned. A person, firm, corporation, or other entity is not a 
contractor under this subsection (1)(c) if the person, firm,

(4) "Filing" means delivery of a document that is required to be

python - <<'PY'
import csv, pathlib, collections
base=pathlib.Path('/app/input_files')
for stem in ('Bond','Insurance'):
 p=base/f'LNI_Contractor_License_{stem}_BR.csv'
 with p.open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f: rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
 exact=collections.Counter(tuple(r.items()) for r in rows)
 print(stem,'exact duplicate groups/extra',sum(v>1 for v in exact.values()),sum(v-1 for v in exact.values()))
 # duplicate candidate identifiers
 for keys in (["contractorlicensenumber","bondaccountid","bondeffectivedate","bondamt"] if stem=='Bond' else ["contractorlicensenumber","insurancepolicyno","effectivedate","insuranceamt"]),:
  c=collections.Counter(tuple(r[k] for k in keys) for r in rows)
  print(' key',keys,'duplicate groups',sum(v>1 for v in c.values()),'extra',sum(v-1 for v in c.values()))
PY

(4) "Filing" means delivery of a document that is required to be

RCW 18.27.040   Bond or other security required —Actions against —
Suspension of registration upon impairment.   (1) Each applicant shall 
file with the department a surety bond issued by a surety insurer who 
meets the requirements of chapter 48.28 RCW  in the sum of $30,000 if 
the applicant is a general contractor or $15,000 if the applicant is a

department at the time the application is filed, a bond must accompany 
the registration application. The bond shall have the state of 
Washington named as obligee with good and sufficient surety in a form 
to be approved by the department. The bond shall be continuous and may 
be canceled by the surety upon the surety giving written notice to the 
director. A cancellation or revocation of the bond or withdrawal of 
the surety from the bond automatically suspends the registration 
issued to the contractor until a new bond or reinstatement notice has 
been filed and approved as provided in this section. The bond shall be 
conditioned that the applicant will pay all persons performing labor, 
including employee benefits, for the contractor, will pay all taxes 
and contributions due to the state of Washington, and will pay all 
persons furnishing material or renting or supplying equipment to the 
contractor and will pay all amounts that may be adjudged against the

the conduct of the contracting business. A change in the name of a

applicants for such bond maintains partial ownership in the business 
covered by the bond.

contractor shall provide a bond or other security deposit as required 
by this chapter and comply with all of the other provisions of this 
chapter before the department shall issue or renew the contractor's 
certificate of registration. Any contractor registered as of June 30, 
2024, who maintains that registration in accordance with this chapter

contractor for any of the items referred to in this section may bring

the bond shall be named as a party to any suit upon the bond. Action 
upon the bond or deposit brought by a residential homeowner for breach 
of contract by a party to the construction contract shall be commenced 
by filing the summons and complaint with the clerk of the appropriate 
superior court within two years from the date the claimed contract 
work was substantially completed or abandoned, whichever occurred 
first. Action upon the bond or deposit brought by any other authorized 
party shall be commenced by filing the summons and complaint with the 
clerk of the appropriate superior court within one year from the date 
the claimed labor was performed and benefits accrued, taxes and 
contributions owing the state of Washington became due, materials and

Service of process in an action filed under this chapter against the 
contractor and the contractor's bond or the deposit shall be

summons and complaint and a fee adopted by rule of not less than $50 
to cover the costs shall be served by registered or certified mail, or 
other delivery service requiring notice of receipt, upon the 
department at the time suit is started and the department shall 
maintain a record, available for public inspection, of all suits so 
commenced. Service is not complete until the department receives the 
fee and three copies of the summons and complaint. The service shall 
constitute service and confer personal jurisdiction on the contractor 
and the surety for suit on claimant's claim against the contractor and 
the bond or deposit and the department shall transmit the summons and 
complaint or a copy thereof to the contractor at the address listed in 
the contractor's application and to the surety within two days after 
it shall have been received.

amount in excess of the amount named in the bond nor for any monetary 
penalty assessed pursuant to this chapter for an infraction. The 
liability of the surety shall not cumulate where the bond has been 
renewed, continued, reinstated, reissued or otherwise extended. The 
surety upon the bond may, upon notice to the department and the 
parties, tender to the clerk of the court having jurisdiction of the

shall be exonerated but if the actions commenced and pending and

RCW 18.27.062   Inspection by department —Subcontractor list —
Certificate of registration.   A contractor must maintain and have 
available for inspection by the department a list of all direct 
subcontractors and a copy of their certificate of registration.  [2009 
c 432 s 1.]
RCW 18.27.065   Partnership or joint venture deemed registered, 
when.  A partnership or joint venture shall be deemed registered under 
this chapter if any one of the general partners or venturers whose 
name appears in the name under which the partnership or venture does 
business is registered.  [1983 1st ex.s. c 2 s 16.]
Effective date —1983 1st ex.s. c 2:  See note following RCW 
18.27.200.
RCW 18.27.070   Fees.   The department shall charge fees for 
issuance, renewal, and reinstatement of certificates of registration; 
and changes of name, address, or business structure. The department 
shall set the fees by rule.
The entire amount of the fees are to be used solely to cover the 
full cost of issuing certificates, filing papers and notices, and 
administering and enforcing this chapter. The costs shall include 
reproduction, travel, per diem, and administrative and legal support 
costs.  [1997 c 314 s 7; 1983 c 74 s 1; 1977 ex.s. c 66 s 1; 1973 1st 
ex.s. c 153 s 5; 1967 c 126 s 2; 1963 c 77 s 7.]
Effective date —1977 ex.s. c 66:  "This 1977 amendatory act is 
necessary for the immediate preservation of the public peace, health, 
and safety, the support of the state government and its existing 
public institutions, and shall take effect on July 1, 1977." [1977 
ex.s. c 66 s 2.]
RCW 18.27.075   Fees for issuing or renewing certificate of 
registration.  The department shall charge a fee of one hundred 
dollars for issuing or renewing a certificate of registration during 
the 2001-2003 biennium. The department shall revise this amount at 
least once every two years for the purpose of recognizing economic 
changes as reflected by the fiscal growth factor under chapter 43.135 
RCW.  [2001 c 159 s 14; 1983 c 74 s 2.]
RCW 18.27.080   Registration prerequisite to suit.   No person 
engaged in the business or acting in the capacity of a contractor may 
bring or maintain any action in any court of this state for the 
collection of compensation for the performance of any work or for 
breach of any contract for which registration is required under this 
chapter without alleging and proving that he or she was a duly 
registered contractor and held a current and valid certificate of 
registration at the time he or she contracted for the performance of 
such work or entered into such contract. For the purposes of this 
section, the court shall not find a contractor in substantial 
compliance with the registration requirements of this chapter unless: 
(1) The department has on file the information required by RCW 
Certified on 7/15/2026 Combined Chapter 18.27 RCW Page 12

===== PAGE 13 =====
18.27.030; (2) the contractor has at all times had in force a current 
bond or other security as required by RCW 18.27.040; and (3) the 
contractor has at all times had in force current insurance as required 
by RCW 18.27.050. In determining under this section whether a 
contractor is in substantial compliance with the registration 
requirements of this chapter, the court shall take into consideration

RCW 18.27.030   Application for registration —Grounds for denial 
and suspension.   (1) An applicant for registration as a contractor 
shall submit an application under oath upon a form to be prescribed by 
the director and which shall include the following information 
pertaining to the applicant:
(a) Employer social security number or individual taxpayer 
identification number.
(b) Unified business identifier number.
(c) Evidence of workers' compensation coverage for the 
applicant's employees working in Washington, as follows:
(i) The applicant's industrial insurance account number issued by 
the department;
(ii) The applicant's self-insurer number issued by the 
department; or
(iii) For applicants domiciled in a state or province of Canada 
subject to an agreement entered into under RCW 51.12.120(7), as 
permitted by the agreement, filing a certificate of coverage issued by 
the agency that administers the workers' compensation law in the 
applicant's state or province of domicile certifying that the 
applicant has secured the payment of compensation under the other 
state's or province's workers' compensation law.
(d) Employment security department number.
(e) Unified business identifier (UBI) account number may be 
substituted for the information required by (c) and (d) of this 
subsection if the applicant will not employ employees in Washington.
(f) Type of contracting activity, whether a general or a 
specialty contractor and if the latter, the type of specialty.
(g) The name and address of each partner if the applicant is a 
firm or partnership, or the name and address of the owner if the 
applicant is an individual proprietorship, or the name and address of 
the corporate officers and statutory agent, if any, if the applicant 
is a corporation or the name and address of all members of other 
business entities. The information contained in such application is a 
matter of public record and open to public inspection.

RCW 18.27.040   Bond or other security required —Actions against —
Suspension of registration upon impairment.   (1) Each applicant shall 
file with the department a surety bond issued by a surety insurer who 
meets the requirements of chapter 48.28 RCW  in the sum of $30,000 if 
the applicant is a general contractor or $15,000 if the applicant is a 
specialty contractor. If no valid bond is already on file with the 
department at the time the application is filed, a bond must accompany 
the registration application. The bond shall have the state of 
Washington named as obligee with good and sufficient surety in a form 
to be approved by the department. The bond shall be continuous and may 
be canceled by the surety upon the surety giving written notice to the 
director. A cancellation or revocation of the bond or withdrawal of 
the surety from the bond automatically suspends the registration 
issued to the contractor until a new bond or reinstatement notice has 
been filed and approved as provided in this section. The bond shall be 
conditioned that the applicant will pay all persons performing labor, 
including employee benefits, for the contractor, will pay all taxes 
and contributions due to the state of Washington, and will pay all 
persons furnishing material or renting or supplying equipment to the 
contractor and will pay all amounts that may be adjudged against the 
contractor by reason of breach of contract including improper work in 
the conduct of the contracting business. A change in the name of a 
Certified on 7/15/2026 Combined Chapter 18.27 RCW Page 7

===== PAGE 8 =====
business or a change in the type of business entity shall not impair a 
bond for the purposes of this section so long as one of the original 
applicants for such bond maintains partial ownership in the business 
covered by the bond.
(2) At the time of initial registration or renewal, the 
contractor shall provide a bond or other security deposit as required 
by this chapter and comply with all of the other provisions of this 
chapter before the department shall issue or renew the contractor's 
certificate of registration. Any contractor registered as of June 30, 
2024, who maintains that registration in accordance with this chapter 
is in compliance with this chapter until the next renewal of the 
contractor's certificate of registration.
(3) Any person, firm, or corporation having a claim against the 
contractor for any of the items referred to in this section may bring 
suit against the contractor and the bond or deposit in the superior 
court of the county in which the work was done or of any county in 
which jurisdiction of the contractor may be had. The surety issuing 
the bond shall be named as a party to any suit upon the bond. Action 
upon the bond or deposit brought by a residential homeowner for breach 
of contract by a party to the construction contract shall be commenced 
by filing the summons and complaint with the clerk of the appropriate 
superior court within two years from the date the claimed contract 
work was substantially completed or abandoned, whichever occurred 
first. Action upon the bond or deposit brought by any other authorized 
party shall be commenced by filing the summons and complaint with the 
clerk of the appropriate superior court within one year from the date 
the claimed labor was performed and benefits accrued, taxes and 
contributions owing the state of Washington became due, materials and 
equipment were furnished, or the claimed contract work was 
substantially completed or abandoned, whichever occurred first. 
Service of process in an action filed under this chapter against the 
contractor and the contractor's bond or the deposit shall be 
exclusively by service upon the department. Three copies of the 
summons and complaint and a fee adopted by rule of not less than $50 
to cover the costs shall be served by registered or certified mail, or 
other delivery service requiring notice of receipt, upon the 
department at the time suit is started and the department shall 
maintain a record, available for public inspection, of all suits so 
commenced. Service is not complete until the department receives the 
fee and three copies of the summons and complaint. The service shall 
constitute service and confer personal jurisdiction on the contractor 
and the surety for suit on claimant's claim against the contractor and 
the bond or deposit and the department shall transmit the summons and 
complaint or a copy thereof to the contractor at the address listed in 
the contractor's application and to the surety within two days after 
it shall have been received.
(4) The surety upon the bond shall not be liable in an aggregate 
amount in excess of the amount named in the bond nor for any monetary 
penalty assessed pursuant to this chapter for an infraction. The 
liability of the surety shall not cumulate where the bond has been 
renewed, continued, reinstated, reissued or otherwise extended. The 
surety upon the bond may, upon notice to the department and the 
parties, tender to the clerk of the court having jurisdiction of the 
action an amount equal to the claims thereunder or the amount of the 
bond less the amount of judgments, if any, previously satisfied 
therefrom and to the extent of such tender the surety upon the bond 
shall be exonerated but if the actions commenced and pending and

def parse_date(value):
    value = (value or "").strip()
    if not value or value == "Until Canceled":
        return None, "blank_or_open"
    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date(), "parsed"
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None, "unparseable"


def money(value):
    try:
        return Decimal(value)
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError):
        return None


def iso(value):
    return value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, date) else ""


def protection_state(row, kind, on_date):
    if kind == "bond":
        start_field = "bondeffectivedate"
        end_fields = ("bondexpirationdate", "bondcanceldate", "bondimpaireddate")
        open_ended = row.get("bondexpirationdate") == "Until Canceled"
    else:
        start_field = "effectivedate"
        end_fields = ("expirationdate", "canceldate")
        open_ended = False

    start, start_status = parse_date(row.get(start_field))
    bad = [field for field in (start_field,) + end_fields if row.get(field) and row.get(field) != "Until Canceled" and parse_date(row.get(field))[1] == "unparseable"]
    if bad:
        return "不确定：日期无法解析", "、".join(bad)
    if start_status != "parsed":
        return "不确定：缺生效日", start_field
    if on_date < start:
        return "否：尚未生效", f"生效日{start.isoformat()}"

    ends = []
    for field in end_fields:
        parsed, status = parse_date(row.get(field))
        if status == "parsed":
            ends.append((parsed, field))
    if ends:
        end, field = min(ends)
        if on_date >= end:
            return "否：已终止", f"{field}={end.isoformat()}（终止当日不计）"
        return "是：日期支持", f"截至{end.isoformat()}前；终止字段{field}"

    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] != "CC":
        return "未确认"
    return "一般" if reg.get("specialtycode1") == "01" or reg.get("specialtycode1desc", "").upper() == "GENERAL" else "专业"


def usual_bond_threshold(reg):
    cls = contractor_class(reg)
    if cls == "一般":
        return Decimal("30000")
    if cls == "专业":
        return Decimal("15000")
    return None


def amount_support(reg, rows, on_date):
    threshold = usual_bond_threshold(reg)
    if threshold is None:
        return "适用范围未确认"
    supported = [(line, row) for line, row in rows if is_supported(row, "bond", on_date)]
    if not supported:
        return "否：无日期可支持记录"
    amounts = [money(row.get("bondamt")) for _, row in supported]
    amounts = [amount for amount in amounts if amount is not None]
    if not amounts:
        return "不确定：金额缺失/无法解析"
    if any(amount >= threshold for amount in amounts):
        return f"是：至少一笔达到通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}"
    return f"否：单笔均低于通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}（不叠加）"


def presence(rows, kind, on_date):
    states = [protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0] for _, row in rows]
    if any(state.startswith("是：") for state in states):
        return "是"
    if any(state.startswith("不确定：") for state in states):
        return "不确定"
    return "否"


def insurance_form(rows, on_date):
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "否":
        return "证据不足：无日期可支持保险行；不等于未投保"
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "不确定":
        return "不确定：日期字段不足，且单一insuranceamt不能证明法定形式"
    return "不足以证明：insuranceamt不含责任分项、除外责任、保单类型或替代账户信息"


def describe_rows(rows, kind):
    if not rows:
        return "无来源行"
    parts = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if kind == "bond":
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('bondeffectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('bondexpirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('bondcanceldate') or '空'}; 减损{row.get('bondimpaireddate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('bondamt') or '空'}"
            )
        else:
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('effectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('expirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('canceldate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('insuranceamt') or '空'}"
            )
    return " | ".join(parts)


def window_gap(rows, kind):
    if not any(is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) for _, row in rows):
        return None
    day = AS_OF + timedelta(days=1)
    gap_start = None
    gap_end = None
    while day <= HORIZON:
        if not any(is_supported(row, kind, day) for _, row in rows):
            if gap_start is None:
                gap_start = day
            gap_end = day
        elif gap_start is not None:
            break
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    if gap_start is None:
        return None
    triggering = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) and not is_supported(row, kind, gap_start):
            triggering.append(line)
    return {"start": gap_start, "end": gap_end, "trigger_lines": triggering}


def duplicate_groups(rows, keys):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in rows:
        groups[tuple(row.get(key, "") for key in keys)].append((line, row))
    return [(key, values) for key, values in groups.items() if len(values) > 1]

def write_sheet(ws, headers, rows, widths=None, freeze="A2", autofilter=True):
    ws.append(headers)

    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)

    ws.freeze_panes = freeze
    if autofilter and ws.max_row >= 1:

    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:

    if widths:

            ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(index)].width = width

def build(input_dir, output_dir):
    for filename in FILES.values():
        path = input_dir / filename
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing input: {path}")
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    general = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["general"])
    bonds = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["bond"])
    insurance = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["insurance"])
    general_rows = list(enumerate(general, 2))
    bond_rows = list(enumerate(bonds, 2))
    insurance_rows = list(enumerate(insurance, 2))

    by_general = {row["contractorlicensenumber"]: (line, row) for line, row in general_rows}
    by_bond = defaultdict(list)
    by_insurance = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in bond_rows:
        by_bond[row["contractorlicensenumber"]].append((line, row))
    for line, row in insurance_rows:
        by_insurance[row["contractorlicensenumber"]].append((line, row))

    shared_ubi = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in general_rows:
        shared_ubi[row["ubi"]].append((line, row["contractorlicensenumber"], row["businessname"]))
    shared_ubi = {key: values for key, values in shared_ubi.items() if len(values) > 1}

    active_both_missing = []
    active_cc_one_side_gap = []
    renewal_risk = []
    for line, reg in general_rows:
        if reg["contractorlicensestatus"] != "ACTIVE":
            continue
        lic = reg["contractorlicensenumber"]
        b_rows = by_bond[lic]
        i_rows = by_insurance[lic]
        b_present = presence(b_rows, "bond", AS_OF)
        i_present = presence(i_rows, "insurance", AS_OF)
        common = {
            "general_line": line,
            "business_name": reg["businessname"],
            "license": lic,
            "ubi": reg["ubi"],
            "type_code": reg["contractorlicensetypecode"],
            "scope": classify_scope(reg),
            "bond_sources": describe_rows(b_rows, "bond"),
            "insurance_sources": describe_rows(i_rows, "insurance"),
        }
        if b_present != "是" and i_present != "是":
            active_both_missing.append(common)
        if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] == "CC" and ((b_present == "是") != (i_present == "是")):
            missing = "保证金" if b_present != "是" else "保险"
            item = dict(common)
            item.update({
                "conclusion": f"登记为ACTIVE，但{missing}无可确认有效记录；仅表示证据不足",
                "statute": "RCW 18.27.040或18.27.050；登记后果见18.27.060(3)（PDF第7–11页）",
                "needed_evidence": f"{missing}或替代形式、连续日期、提交和批准资料、实时登记状态",
                "next_step": "向L&I按完整执照号核验；不以状态列替代保障证明",
            })
            active_cc_one_side_gap.append(item)
        gaps = []
        for kind, kind_cn, rows in (("bond", "保证金", b_rows), ("insurance", "保险", i_rows)):
            gap = window_gap(rows, kind)
            if gap:
                gaps.append({
                    "kind": kind,
                    "kind_cn": kind_cn,
                    "gap_start": iso(gap["start"]),
                    "gap_end": iso(gap["end"]),
                    "trigger_lines": ",".join(str(x) for x in gap["trigger_lines"]),
                })
        if gaps:
            item = dict(common)
            item.update({
                "gaps": gaps,
                "statute": "CC：RCW 18.27.040/050及18.27.060(3)；非CC：本包未确认适用",
                "needed_evidence": "后继/恢复保障、替代账户、提交与批准凭证、实时登记状态",
                "next_step": "在最早缺口日前核验整个窗口是否无缝覆盖；不得只比较两个端点",
            })
            renewal_risk.append(item)

    active_both_missing.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])
    active_cc_one_side_gap.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])
    renewal_risk.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])

    lapse_review = []
    for line, reg in general_rows:
        if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] != "CC" or reg["contractorlicensestatus"] != "EXPIRED":
            continue
        expiration, status = parse_date(reg["licenseexpirationdate"])
        if status != "parsed":
            continue
        days = (AS_OF - expiration).days
        if 0 <= days <= 30:
            lic = reg["contractorlicensenumber"]
            b_rows = by_bond[lic]
            i_rows = by_insurance[lic]
            lapse_review.append({
                "general_line": line,
                "business_name": reg["businessname"],
                "license": lic,
                "ubi": reg["ubi"],
                "status": reg["contractorlicensestatus"],
                "expiration": expiration.isoformat(),
                "days_since_expiration": days,
                "bond_sources": describe_rows(b_rows, "bond"),
                "insurance_sources": describe_rows(i_rows, "insurance"),
                "conclusion": "仅凭EXPIRED和到期日不能排除或放行；包内保障缺失/不足不能证明例外条件成立或不成立",
                "next_step": "RCW 18.27.010(15)，PDF第3–4页：核验届满不超过30日及整个期间持续保证金、保险/指定账户；不推定实际承揽",
            })
    lapse_review.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])

    exceptions = []
    for ubi, values in sorted(shared_ubi.items()):
        details = " | ".join(f"登记行{line}: {lic}, {name}" for line, lic, name in values)
        exceptions.append({
            "category": "多个执照共用UBI", "key": ubi, "details": details, "count": len(values),
            "treatment": "UBI仅供身份核对；每个执照独立连接保障，禁止跨执照挪用。",
        })

    general_dupes = duplicate_groups(general_rows, ("contractorlicensenumber",))
    bond_key_dupes = duplicate_groups(bond_rows, ("contractorlicensenumber", "bondaccountid", "bondeffectivedate", "bondamt"))
    ins_key_dupes = duplicate_groups(insurance_rows, ("contractorlicensenumber", "insurancepolicyno", "effectivedate", "insuranceamt"))
    exact_bond = duplicate_groups(bond_rows, tuple(bonds[0].keys()))
    exact_ins = duplicate_groups(insurance_rows, tuple(insurance[0].keys()))

    for label, groups in (("保证金候选键重复", bond_key_dupes), ("保险候选键重复", ins_key_dupes)):
        for key, values in groups:
            details = " | ".join(
                f"行{line}: 企业={row['businessname']}; 提供方={row.get('bondfirmname') or row.get('insurancecompany')}; "
                f"到期={row.get('bondexpirationdate') or row.get('expirationdate')}; 取消={row.get('bondcanceldate') or row.get('canceldate')}"
                for line, row in values
            )
            exceptions.append({
                "category": label, "key": " / ".join(key), "details": details, "count": len(values),
                "treatment": "全部来源行保留；候选键不是可靠唯一主键，冲突须向数据提供方核验。",
            })
    if exact_bond:
        for key, values in exact_bond:
            exceptions.append({
                "category": "保证金完全重复行", "key": values[0][1]["contractorlicensenumber"],
                "details": "来源行" + ",".join(str(line) for line, _ in values), "count": len(values),
                "treatment": "不删除、不重复计额；保留行级可追溯性。",
            })
    if exact_ins:
        for key, values in exact_ins:
            exceptions.append({
                "category": "保险完全重复行", "key": values[0][1]["contractorlicensenumber"],
                "details": "来源行" + ",".join(str(line) for line, _ in values), "count": len(values),
                "treatment": "不删除、不重复计额；保留行级可追溯性。",
            })

    general_licenses = set(by_general)
    bond_orphans = sorted(set(by_bond) - general_licenses)
    insurance_orphans = sorted(set(by_insurance) - general_licenses)
    exceptions.extend([
        {"category": "登记执照号重复汇总", "key": "General", "details": "未发现" if not general_dupes else str(len(general_dupes)), "count": len(general_dupes), "treatment": "General中执照号可作本包登记主键候选。"},
        {"category": "保证金孤立执照汇总", "key": "Bond→General", "details": "未发现" if not bond_orphans else ",".join(bond_orphans), "count": len(bond_orphans), "treatment": "如发现应单独交接；本包未发现。"},
        {"category": "保险孤立执照汇总", "key": "Insurance→General", "details": "未发现" if not insurance_orphans else ",".join(insurance_orphans), "count": len(insurance_orphans), "treatment": "如发现应单独交接；本包未发现。"},
        {"category": "同执照不同名称/UBI汇总", "key": "三表内部及对General", "details": "未发现", "count": 0, "treatment": "按完整执照号比对名称和UBI；本包未见冲突。"},
        {"category": "主键字段缺失汇总", "key": "执照号/UBI/企业名", "details": "三表均未发现缺失", "count": 0, "treatment": "保留检查结果。"},
    ])

    future_rows = []
    for line, row in bond_rows:
        effective, status = parse_date(row["bondeffectivedate"])
        if status == "parsed" and effective > AS_OF:
            future_rows.append((line, row))
    historical_examples = []
    for lic in ("BRIGHHI063D3", "BRIANEI984B5", "BRISTEL757JZ"):
        line, reg = by_general[lic]
        historical_examples.append(
            f"{lic}（{reg['businessname']}，登记行{line}，UBI {reg['ubi']}）：{describe_rows(by_bond[lic], 'bond')}；{describe_rows(by_insurance[lic], 'insurance')}。历史/缺失行不能替代2026-10-12有效证明；适用范围为{classify_scope(reg)}。"
        )
    future_examples = []
    for line, row in future_rows[:5]:
        lic = row["contractorlicensenumber"]
        future_examples.append(
            f"{lic}（{row['businessname']}，UBI {row['ubi']}）保证金行{line}生效日{row['bondeffectivedate']}，在2026-10-12尚未生效，不能提前计入；该执照另有当前来源行时须分别判断，不能因未来行倒推当前有效。"
        )
    status_examples = []
    for item in active_cc_one_side_gap[:5]:
        status_examples.append(
            f"{item['license']}（{item['business_name']}，登记行{item['general_line']}，UBI {item['ubi']}）登记为ACTIVE，但保障证据为：{item['conclusion']}。来源：保证金{item['bond_sources']}；保险{item['insurance_sources']}。应补实时状态、替代形式及提交/批准资料，不据此认定违法。"
        )

    counts = {
        "general_rows": len(general),
        "general_licenses": len(general_licenses),
        "bond_rows": len(bonds),
        "bond_licenses": len(by_bond),
        "insurance_rows": len(insurance),
        "insurance_licenses": len(by_insurance),
        "active_registrations": sum(row["contractorlicensestatus"] == "ACTIVE" for row in general),
        "shared_ubi_groups": len(shared_ubi),
        "bond_orphan_licenses": len(bond_orphans),
        "insurance_orphan_licenses": len(insurance_orphans),
        "general_duplicate_license_groups": len(general_dupes),
        "bond_candidate_key_duplicate_groups": len(bond_key_dupes),
        "insurance_candidate_key_duplicate_groups": len(ins_key_dupes),
        "bond_exact_duplicate_groups": len(exact_bond),
        "insurance_exact_duplicate_groups": len(exact_ins),
    }

    data = {
        "metadata": {
            "title": "Washington L&I BR contractor public-record evidence review",
            "as_of": AS_OF.isoformat(),
            "horizon": HORIZON.isoformat(),
            "statute_snapshot_certified": "2026-07-15",
            "disclaimer": "Screening and evidence-gap analysis only; not a final legal opinion or agency determination.",
            "date_boundary": "Effective date included; expiration/cancellation/impairment date excluded from that date; day-level screening convention.",
            "join_rule": "Exact contractor license number only; never reassign protection by UBI or similar name.",
        },
        "counts": counts,
        "legal_matrix": LEGAL_MATRIX,
        "active_both_missing": active_both_missing,
        "active_cc_one_side_gap": active_cc_one_side_gap,
        "renewal_risk": renewal_risk,
        "lapse_review": lapse_review,
        "examples": {"historical": historical_examples, "future": future_examples, "status_mismatch": status_examples},
        "exceptions": exceptions,
        "orphan_handoff": {"bond_licenses": bond_orphans, "insurance_licenses": insurance_orphans},
        "limitations": [
            "Missing record means insufficient evidence, not absence of bond or insurance.",
            "insuranceamt alone cannot establish statutory limits by category, exclusions, policy form, or assigned-account alternative.",
            "Until Canceled is not unconditional permanent validity.",
            "Non-CC legal requirements are outside the supplied RCW 18.27 PDF and remain unconfirmed.",
            "The supplied PDF is not evidence of every historical version of the statute.",
        ],
    }

    make_xlsx(output_dir / "audit.xlsx", data, general_rows, bond_rows, insurance_rows, by_bond, by_insurance)
    make_docx(output_dir / "memo.docx", data)
    with (output_dir / "results.json").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(data, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        handle.write("\n")
    return data


def verify(output_dir):
    expected = {"analysis.py", "audit.xlsx", "memo.docx", "results.json"}
    present = {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    missing = expected - present
    extra = present - expected
    if missing or extra:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Output file set mismatch; missing={sorted(missing)}, extra={sorted(extra)}")
    wb = load_workbook(output_dir / "audit.xlsx", read_only=True, data_only=True)
    required_sheets = {"说明", "法律矩阵", "逐执照", "保证金记录", "保险记录", "待核验与续期", "数据例外", "30日届满例外"}
    if set(wb.sheetnames) != required_sheets:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Workbook sheet mismatch: {wb.sheetnames}")
    if wb["逐执照"].max_row != 1554 or wb["保证金记录"].max_row != 1725 or wb["保险记录"].max_row != 738:
        raise RuntimeError("Workbook source row preservation check failed")
    Document(output_dir / "memo.docx")
    with (output_dir / "results.json").open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:

def read_csv(path):

def parse_date(value):
    value = (value or "").strip()
    if not value or value == "Until Canceled":
        return None, "blank_or_open"
    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date(), "parsed"
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None, "unparseable"


def money(value):
    try:
        return Decimal(value)
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError):
        return None


def iso(value):
    return value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, date) else ""


def protection_state(row, kind, on_date):
    if kind == "bond":
        start_field = "bondeffectivedate"
        end_fields = ("bondexpirationdate", "bondcanceldate", "bondimpaireddate")
        open_ended = row.get("bondexpirationdate") == "Until Canceled"
    else:
        start_field = "effectivedate"
        end_fields = ("expirationdate", "canceldate")
        open_ended = False

    start, start_status = parse_date(row.get(start_field))
    bad = [field for field in (start_field,) + end_fields if row.get(field) and row.get(field) != "Until Canceled" and parse_date(row.get(field))[1] == "unparseable"]
    if bad:
        return "不确定：日期无法解析", "、".join(bad)
    if start_status != "parsed":
        return "不确定：缺生效日", start_field
    if on_date < start:
        return "否：尚未生效", f"生效日{start.isoformat()}"

    ends = []
    for field in end_fields:
        parsed, status = parse_date(row.get(field))
        if status == "parsed":
            ends.append((parsed, field))
    if ends:
        end, field = min(ends)
        if on_date >= end:
            return "否：已终止", f"{field}={end.isoformat()}（终止当日不计）"
        return "是：日期支持", f"截至{end.isoformat()}前；终止字段{field}"
    if open_ended:
        return "是：日期支持（Until Canceled）", "未见取消/减损日；不代表永久或无条件有效"
    return "不确定：缺终止依据", "无到期/取消/减损日期，也非Until Canceled"


def is_supported(row, kind, on_date):
    return protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0].startswith("是：")

    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] == "CC":
        return "RCW 18.27直接筛查（仍须核验活动与豁免）"
    return "本包未确认适用；转相应专门许可制度核验"


def contractor_class(reg):
    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] != "CC":
        return "未确认"
    return "一般" if reg.get("specialtycode1") == "01" or reg.get("specialtycode1desc", "").upper() == "GENERAL" else "专业"


def usual_bond_threshold(reg):
    cls = contractor_class(reg)
    if cls == "一般":
        return Decimal("30000")
    if cls == "专业":
        return Decimal("15000")
    return None


def amount_support(reg, rows, on_date):
    threshold = usual_bond_threshold(reg)
    if threshold is None:
        return "适用范围未确认"
    supported = [(line, row) for line, row in rows if is_supported(row, "bond", on_date)]
    if not supported:
        return "否：无日期可支持记录"
    amounts = [money(row.get("bondamt")) for _, row in supported]
    amounts = [amount for amount in amounts if amount is not None]
    if not amounts:
        return "不确定：金额缺失/无法解析"
    if any(amount >= threshold for amount in amounts):
        return f"是：至少一笔达到通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}"
    return f"否：单笔均低于通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}（不叠加）"


def presence(rows, kind, on_date):
    states = [protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0] for _, row in rows]
    if any(state.startswith("是：") for state in states):
        return "是"
    if any(state.startswith("不确定：") for state in states):
        return "不确定"
    return "否"


def insurance_form(rows, on_date):
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "否":
        return "证据不足：无日期可支持保险行；不等于未投保"
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "不确定":

        else:
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('effectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('expirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('canceldate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('insuranceamt') or '空'}"

    return " | ".join(parts)


def window_gap(rows, kind):
    if not any(is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) for _, row in rows):
        return None
    day = AS_OF + timedelta(days=1)
    gap_start = None
    gap_end = None
    while day <= HORIZON:
        if not any(is_supported(row, kind, day) for _, row in rows):
            if gap_start is None:
                gap_start = day
            gap_end = day
        elif gap_start is not None:
            break
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    if gap_start is None:
        return None
    triggering = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) and not is_supported(row, kind, gap_start):
            triggering.append(line)
    return {"start": gap_start, "end": gap_end, "trigger_lines": triggering}


def duplicate_groups(rows, keys):
    groups = defaultdict(list)

    return [(key, values) for key, values in groups.items() if len(values) > 1]

def write_sheet(ws, headers, rows, widths=None, freeze="A2", autofilter=True):
    ws.append(headers)

        ws.append(row)
    fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
        cell.fill = fill
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    ws.freeze_panes = freeze
    if autofilter and ws.max_row >= 1:
        ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
    if widths:
        for index, width in enumerate(widths, 1):
            ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(index)].width = width

def build(input_dir, output_dir):
    for filename in FILES.values():
        path = input_dir / filename
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing input: {path}")
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    general = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["general"])
    bonds = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["bond"])
    insurance = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["insurance"])
    general_rows = list(enumerate(general, 2))
    bond_rows = list(enumerate(bonds, 2))
    insurance_rows = list(enumerate(insurance, 2))

    by_general = {row["contractorlicensenumber"]: (line, row) for line, row in general_rows}
    by_bond = defaultdict(list)
    by_insurance = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in bond_rows:
        by_bond[row["contractorlicensenumber"]].append((line, row))
    for line, row in insurance_rows:
        by_insurance[row["contractorlicensenumber"]].append((line, row))

    shared_ubi = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in general_rows:
        shared_ubi[row["ubi"]].append((line, row["contractorlicensenumber"], row["businessname"]))
    shared_ubi = {key: values for key, values in shared_ubi.items() if len(values) > 1}

    active_both_missing = []
    active_cc_one_side_gap = []
    renewal_risk = []
    for line, reg in general_rows:
        if reg["contractorlicensestatus"] != "ACTIVE":
            continue
        lic = reg["contractorlicensenumber"]
        b_rows = by_bond[lic]
        i_rows = by_insurance[lic]
        b_present = presence(b_rows, "bond", AS_OF)
        i_present = presence(i_rows, "insurance", AS_OF)
        common = {
            "general_line": line,
            "business_name": reg["businessname"],
            "license": lic,
            "ubi": reg["ubi"],
            "type_code": reg["contractorlicensetypecode"],
            "scope": classify_scope(reg),
            "bond_sources": describe_rows(b_rows, "bond"),
            "insurance_sources": describe_rows(i_rows, "insurance"),
        }
        if b_present != "是" and i_present != "是":
            active_both_missing.append(common)
        if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] == "CC" and ((b_present == "是") != (i_present == "是")):
            missing = "保证金" if b_present != "是" else "保险"
            item = dict(common)
            item.update({

        handle.write("\n")

def verify(output_dir):
    expected = {"analysis.py", "audit.xlsx", "memo.docx", "results.json"}
    present = {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    missing = expected - present
    extra = present - expected
    if missing or extra:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Output file set mismatch; missing={sorted(missing)}, extra={sorted(extra)}")
    wb = load_workbook(output_dir / "audit.xlsx", read_only=True, data_only=True)
    required_sheets = {"说明", "法律矩阵", "逐执照", "保证金记录", "保险记录", "待核验与续期", "数据例外", "30日届满例外"}
    if set(wb.sheetnames) != required_sheets:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Workbook sheet mismatch: {wb.sheetnames}")
    if wb["逐执照"].max_row != 1554 or wb["保证金记录"].max_row != 1725 or wb["保险记录"].max_row != 738:
        raise RuntimeError("Workbook source row preservation check failed")
    Document(output_dir / "memo.docx")
    with (output_dir / "results.json").open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        parsed = json.load(handle)
    if parsed["metadata"]["as_of"] != AS_OF.isoformat():
        raise RuntimeError("JSON date verification failed")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build BR contractor evidence-review deliverables from L&I CSV snapshots and RCW PDF.")
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    build(args.input, args.output)
    verify(args.output)
    print(f"Generated and verified audit.xlsx, memo.docx, results.json in {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    if not value or value == "Until Canceled":
        return None, "blank_or_open"
    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date(), "parsed"
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None, "unparseable"

    try:

        return None

        open_ended = False

    start, start_status = parse_date(row.get(start_field))
    bad = [field for field in (start_field,) + end_fields if row.get(field) and row.get(field) != "Until Canceled" and parse_date(row.get(field))[1] == "unparseable"]
    if bad:
        return "不确定：日期无法解析", "、".join(bad)
    if start_status != "parsed":
        return "不确定：缺生效日", start_field
    if on_date < start:
        return "否：尚未生效", f"生效日{start.isoformat()}"

    ends = []
    for field in end_fields:
        parsed, status = parse_date(row.get(field))
        if status == "parsed":
            ends.append((parsed, field))
    if ends:
        end, field = min(ends)
        if on_date >= end:
            return "否：已终止", f"{field}={end.isoformat()}（终止当日不计）"
        return "是：日期支持", f"截至{end.isoformat()}前；终止字段{field}"
    if open_ended:
        return "是：日期支持（Until Canceled）", "未见取消/减损日；不代表永久或无条件有效"
    return "不确定：缺终止依据", "无到期/取消/减损日期，也非Until Canceled"


def is_supported(row, kind, on_date):
    return protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0].startswith("是：")


def classify_scope(reg):
    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] == "CC":
        return "RCW 18.27直接筛查（仍须核验活动与豁免）"
    return "本包未确认适用；转相应专门许可制度核验"


def contractor_class(reg):
    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] != "CC":
        return "未确认"
    return "一般" if reg.get("specialtycode1") == "01" or reg.get("specialtycode1desc", "").upper() == "GENERAL" else "专业"


def usual_bond_threshold(reg):
    cls = contractor_class(reg)
    if cls == "一般":
        return Decimal("30000")
    if cls == "专业":
        return Decimal("15000")
    return None


def amount_support(reg, rows, on_date):
    threshold = usual_bond_threshold(reg)
    if threshold is None:
        return "适用范围未确认"
    supported = [(line, row) for line, row in rows if is_supported(row, "bond", on_date)]
    if not supported:
        return "否：无日期可支持记录"
    amounts = [money(row.get("bondamt")) for _, row in supported]
    amounts = [amount for amount in amounts if amount is not None]
    if not amounts:
        return "不确定：金额缺失/无法解析"
    if any(amount >= threshold for amount in amounts):
        return f"是：至少一笔达到通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}"
    return f"否：单笔均低于通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}（不叠加）"


def presence(rows, kind, on_date):
    states = [protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0] for _, row in rows]
    if any(state.startswith("是：") for state in states):
        return "是"
    if any(state.startswith("不确定：") for state in states):
        return "不确定"
    return "否"


def insurance_form(rows, on_date):
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "否":
        return "证据不足：无日期可支持保险行；不等于未投保"
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "不确定":
        return "不确定：日期字段不足，且单一insuranceamt不能证明法定形式"
    return "不足以证明：insuranceamt不含责任分项、除外责任、保单类型或替代账户信息"


def describe_rows(rows, kind):
    if not rows:
        return "无来源行"
    parts = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if kind == "bond":
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('bondeffectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('bondexpirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('bondcanceldate') or '空'}; 减损{row.get('bondimpaireddate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('bondamt') or '空'}"
            )
        else:
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('effectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('expirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('canceldate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('insuranceamt') or '空'}"
            )
    return " | ".join(parts)


def window_gap(rows, kind):
    if not any(is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) for _, row in rows):
        return None
    day = AS_OF + timedelta(days=1)
    gap_start = None
    gap_end = None
    while day <= HORIZON:
        if not any(is_supported(row, kind, day) for _, row in rows):
            if gap_start is None:
                gap_start = day
            gap_end = day
        elif gap_start is not None:
            break
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    if gap_start is None:
        return None
    triggering = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) and not is_supported(row, kind, gap_start):
            triggering.append(line)
    return {"start": gap_start, "end": gap_end, "trigger_lines": triggering}


def duplicate_groups(rows, keys):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in rows:
        groups[tuple(row.get(key, "") for key in keys)].append((line, row))
    return [(key, values) for key, values in groups.items() if len(values) > 1]

def write_sheet(ws, headers, rows, widths=None, freeze="A2", autofilter=True):
    ws.append(headers)
    for row in rows:
        ws.append(row)
    fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
        cell.fill = fill
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    ws.freeze_panes = freeze
    if autofilter and ws.max_row >= 1:
        ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
    if widths:
        for index, width in enumerate(widths, 1):
            ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(index)].width = width

def build(input_dir, output_dir):
    for filename in FILES.values():
        path = input_dir / filename
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing input: {path}")
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    general = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["general"])
    bonds = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["bond"])
    insurance = read_csv(input_dir / FILES["insurance"])
    general_rows = list(enumerate(general, 2))
    bond_rows = list(enumerate(bonds, 2))
    insurance_rows = list(enumerate(insurance, 2))

    by_general = {row["contractorlicensenumber"]: (line, row) for line, row in general_rows}
    by_bond = defaultdict(list)
    by_insurance = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in bond_rows:
        by_bond[row["contractorlicensenumber"]].append((line, row))
    for line, row in insurance_rows:
        by_insurance[row["contractorlicensenumber"]].append((line, row))

    shared_ubi = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in general_rows:
        shared_ubi[row["ubi"]].append((line, row["contractorlicensenumber"], row["businessname"]))
    shared_ubi = {key: values for key, values in shared_ubi.items() if len(values) > 1}

    active_both_missing = []
    active_cc_one_side_gap = []
    renewal_risk = []
    for line, reg in general_rows:
        if reg["contractorlicensestatus"] != "ACTIVE":
            continue
        lic = reg["contractorlicensenumber"]
        b_rows = by_bond[lic]
        i_rows = by_insurance[lic]
        b_present = presence(b_rows, "bond", AS_OF)
        i_present = presence(i_rows, "insurance", AS_OF)
        common = {
            "general_line": line,
            "business_name": reg["businessname"],
            "license": lic,
            "ubi": reg["ubi"],
            "type_code": reg["contractorlicensetypecode"],
            "scope": classify_scope(reg),
            "bond_sources": describe_rows(b_rows, "bond"),
            "insurance_sources": describe_rows(i_rows, "insurance"),
        }
        if b_present != "是" and i_present != "是":
            active_both_missing.append(common)
        if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] == "CC" and ((b_present == "是") != (i_present == "是")):
            missing = "保证金" if b_present != "是" else "保险"
            item = dict(common)
            item.update({
                "conclusion": f"登记为ACTIVE，但{missing}无可确认有效记录；仅表示证据不足",
                "statute": "RCW 18.27.040或18.27.050；登记后果见18.27.060(3)（PDF第7–11页）",
                "needed_evidence": f"{missing}或替代形式、连续日期、提交和批准资料、实时登记状态",
                "next_step": "向L&I按完整执照号核验；不以状态列替代保障证明",
            })
            active_cc_one_side_gap.append(item)
        gaps = []
        for kind, kind_cn, rows in (("bond", "保证金", b_rows), ("insurance", "保险", i_rows)):
            gap = window_gap(rows, kind)
            if gap:
                gaps.append({
                    "kind": kind,
                    "kind_cn": kind_cn,
                    "gap_start": iso(gap["start"]),
                    "gap_end": iso(gap["end"]),
                    "trigger_lines": ",".join(str(x) for x in gap["trigger_lines"]),
                })
        if gaps:
            item = dict(common)
            item.update({
                "gaps": gaps,
                "statute": "CC：RCW 18.27.040/050及18.27.060(3)；非CC：本包未确认适用",
                "needed_evidence": "后继/恢复保障、替代账户、提交与批准凭证、实时登记状态",
                "next_step": "在最早缺口日前核验整个窗口是否无缝覆盖；不得只比较两个端点",
            })
            renewal_risk.append(item)

    active_both_missing.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])
    active_cc_one_side_gap.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])
    renewal_risk.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])

    lapse_review = []
    for line, reg in general_rows:
        if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] != "CC" or reg["contractorlicensestatus"] != "EXPIRED":
            continue
        expiration, status = parse_date(reg["licenseexpirationdate"])
        if status != "parsed":
            continue
        days = (AS_OF - expiration).days
        if 0 <= days <= 30:
            lic = reg["contractorlicensenumber"]
            b_rows = by_bond[lic]
            i_rows = by_insurance[lic]
            lapse_review.append({
                "general_line": line,
                "business_name": reg["businessname"],
                "license": lic,
                "ubi": reg["ubi"],
                "status": reg["contractorlicensestatus"],
                "expiration": expiration.isoformat(),
                "days_since_expiration": days,
                "bond_sources": describe_rows(b_rows, "bond"),
                "insurance_sources": describe_rows(i_rows, "insurance"),
                "conclusion": "仅凭EXPIRED和到期日不能排除或放行；包内保障缺失/不足不能证明例外条件成立或不成立",
                "next_step": "RCW 18.27.010(15)，PDF第3–4页：核验届满不超过30日及整个期间持续保证金、保险/指定账户；不推定实际承揽",
            })
    lapse_review.sort(key=lambda x: x["license"])

    exceptions = []
    for ubi, values in sorted(shared_ubi.items()):
        details = " | ".join(f"登记行{line}: {lic}, {name}" for line, lic, name in values)
        exceptions.append({
            "category": "多个执照共用UBI", "key": ubi, "details": details, "count": len(values),
            "treatment": "UBI仅供身份核对；每个执照独立连接保障，禁止跨执照挪用。",
        })

    general_dupes = duplicate_groups(general_rows, ("contractorlicensenumber",))
    bond_key_dupes = duplicate_groups(bond_rows, ("contractorlicensenumber", "bondaccountid", "bondeffectivedate", "bondamt"))
    ins_key_dupes = duplicate_groups(insurance_rows, ("contractorlicensenumber", "insurancepolicyno", "effectivedate", "insuranceamt"))
    exact_bond = duplicate_groups(bond_rows, tuple(bonds[0].keys()))
    exact_ins = duplicate_groups(insurance_rows, tuple(insurance[0].keys()))

    for label, groups in (("保证金候选键重复", bond_key_dupes), ("保险候选键重复", ins_key_dupes)):
        for key, values in groups:
            details = " | ".join(
                f"行{line}: 企业={row['businessname']}; 提供方={row.get('bondfirmname') or row.get('insurancecompany')}; "
                f"到期={row.get('bondexpirationdate') or row.get('expirationdate')}; 取消={row.get('bondcanceldate') or row.get('canceldate')}"
                for line, row in values
            )
            exceptions.append({
                "category": label, "key": " / ".join(key), "details": details, "count": len(values),
                "treatment": "全部来源行保留；候选键不是可靠唯一主键，冲突须向数据提供方核验。",
            })
    if exact_bond:
        for key, values in exact_bond:
            exceptions.append({
                "category": "保证金完全重复行", "key": values[0][1]["contractorlicensenumber"],
                "details": "来源行" + ",".join(str(line) for line, _ in values), "count": len(values),
                "treatment": "不删除、不重复计额；保留行级可追溯性。",
            })
    if exact_ins:
        for key, values in exact_ins:
            exceptions.append({
                "category": "保险完全重复行", "key": values[0][1]["contractorlicensenumber"],
                "details": "来源行" + ",".join(str(line) for line, _ in values), "count": len(values),
                "treatment": "不删除、不重复计额；保留行级可追溯性。",
            })

    general_licenses = set(by_general)
    bond_orphans = sorted(set(by_bond) - general_licenses)
    insurance_orphans = sorted(set(by_insurance) - general_licenses)
    exceptions.extend([
        {"category": "登记执照号重复汇总", "key": "General", "details": "未发现" if not general_dupes else str(len(general_dupes)), "count": len(general_dupes), "treatment": "General中执照号可作本包登记主键候选。"},
        {"category": "保证金孤立执照汇总", "key": "Bond→General", "details": "未发现" if not bond_orphans else ",".join(bond_orphans), "count": len(bond_orphans), "treatment": "如发现应单独交接；本包未发现。"},
        {"category": "保险孤立执照汇总", "key": "Insurance→General", "details": "未发现" if not insurance_orphans else ",".join(insurance_orphans), "count": len(insurance_orphans), "treatment": "如发现应单独交接；本包未发现。"},
        {"category": "同执照不同名称/UBI汇总", "key": "三表内部及对General", "details": "未发现", "count": 0, "treatment": "按完整执照号比对名称和UBI；本包未见冲突。"},
        {"category": "主键字段缺失汇总", "key": "执照号/UBI/企业名", "details": "三表均未发现缺失", "count": 0, "treatment": "保留检查结果。"},
    ])

    future_rows = []
    for line, row in bond_rows:
        effective, status = parse_date(row["bondeffectivedate"])
        if status == "parsed" and effective > AS_OF:
            future_rows.append((line, row))
    historical_examples = []
    for lic in ("BRIGHHI063D3", "BRIANEI984B5", "BRISTEL757JZ"):
        line, reg = by_general[lic]
        historical_examples.append(
            f"{lic}（{reg['businessname']}，登记行{line}，UBI {reg['ubi']}）：{describe_rows(by_bond[lic], 'bond')}；{describe_rows(by_insurance[lic], 'insurance')}。历史/缺失行不能替代2026-10-12有效证明；适用范围为{classify_scope(reg)}。"
        )
    future_examples = []
    for line, row in future_rows[:5]:
        lic = row["contractorlicensenumber"]
        future_examples.append(
            f"{lic}（{row['businessname']}，UBI {row['ubi']}）保证金行{line}生效日{row['bondeffectivedate']}，在2026-10-12尚未生效，不能提前计入；该执照另有当前来源行时须分别判断，不能因未来行倒推当前有效。"
        )
    status_examples = []
    for item in active_cc_one_side_gap[:5]:
        status_examples.append(
            f"{item['license']}（{item['business_name']}，登记行{item['general_line']}，UBI {item['ubi']}）登记为ACTIVE，但保障证据为：{item['conclusion']}。来源：保证金{item['bond_sources']}；保险{item['insurance_sources']}。应补实时状态、替代形式及提交/批准资料，不据此认定违法。"
        )

    counts = {
        "general_rows": len(general),
        "general_licenses": len(general_licenses),
        "bond_rows": len(bonds),
        "bond_licenses": len(by_bond),
        "insurance_rows": len(insurance),
        "insurance_licenses": len(by_insurance),
        "active_registrations": sum(row["contractorlicensestatus"] == "ACTIVE" for row in general),
        "shared_ubi_groups": len(shared_ubi),
        "bond_orphan_licenses": len(bond_orphans),
        "insurance_orphan_licenses": len(insurance_orphans),
        "general_duplicate_license_groups": len(general_dupes),
        "bond_candidate_key_duplicate_groups": len(bond_key_dupes),
        "insurance_candidate_key_duplicate_groups": len(ins_key_dupes),
        "bond_exact_duplicate_groups": len(exact_bond),
        "insurance_exact_duplicate_groups": len(exact_ins),
    }

    data = {
        "metadata": {
            "title": "Washington L&I BR contractor public-record evidence review",
            "as_of": AS_OF.isoformat(),
            "horizon": HORIZON.isoformat(),
            "statute_snapshot_certified": "2026-07-15",
            "disclaimer": "Screening and evidence-gap analysis only; not a final legal opinion or agency determination.",
            "date_boundary": "Effective date included; expiration/cancellation/impairment date excluded from that date; day-level screening convention.",
            "join_rule": "Exact contractor license number only; never reassign protection by UBI or similar name.",
        },
        "counts": counts,
        "legal_matrix": LEGAL_MATRIX,
        "active_both_missing": active_both_missing,
        "active_cc_one_side_gap": active_cc_one_side_gap,
        "renewal_risk": renewal_risk,
        "lapse_review": lapse_review,
        "examples": {"historical": historical_examples, "future": future_examples, "status_mismatch": status_examples},
        "exceptions": exceptions,

            "Non-CC legal requirements are outside the supplied RCW 18.27 PDF and remain unconfirmed.",

        ],
    }

    make_xlsx(output_dir / "audit.xlsx", data, general_rows, bond_rows, insurance_rows, by_bond, by_insurance)
    make_docx(output_dir / "memo.docx", data)
    with (output_dir / "results.json").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(data, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        handle.write("\n")
    return data


def verify(output_dir):
    expected = {"analysis.py", "audit.xlsx", "memo.docx", "results.json"}
    present = {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    missing = expected - present
    extra = present - expected
    if missing or extra:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Output file set mismatch; missing={sorted(missing)}, extra={sorted(extra)}")
    wb = load_workbook(output_dir / "audit.xlsx", read_only=True, data_only=True)

    Document(output_dir / "memo.docx")
    with (output_dir / "results.json").open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        parsed = json.load(handle)
    if parsed["metadata"]["as_of"] != AS_OF.isoformat():
        raise RuntimeError("JSON date verification failed")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build BR contractor evidence-review deliverables from L&I CSV snapshots and RCW PDF.")
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    build(args.input, args.output)
    verify(args.output)
    print(f"Generated and verified audit.xlsx, memo.docx, results.json in {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def parse_date(value):
    value = (value or "").strip()
    if not value or value == "Until Canceled":
        return None, "blank_or_open"
    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date(), "parsed"
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None, "unparseable"


def money(value):
    try:
        return Decimal(value)
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError):
        return None


def iso(value):
    return value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, date) else ""


def protection_state(row, kind, on_date):
    if kind == "bond":
        start_field = "bondeffectivedate"
        end_fields = ("bondexpirationdate", "bondcanceldate", "bondimpaireddate")
        open_ended = row.get("bondexpirationdate") == "Until Canceled"
    else:
        start_field = "effectivedate"
        end_fields = ("expirationdate", "canceldate")
        open_ended = False

    start, start_status = parse_date(row.get(start_field))
    bad = [field for field in (start_field,) + end_fields if row.get(field) and row.get(field) != "Until Canceled" and parse_date(row.get(field))[1] == "unparseable"]
    if bad:
        return "不确定：日期无法解析", "、".join(bad)
    if start_status != "parsed":
        return "不确定：缺生效日", start_field
    if on_date < start:
        return "否：尚未生效", f"生效日{start.isoformat()}"

    ends = []
    for field in end_fields:
        parsed, status = parse_date(row.get(field))
        if status == "parsed":
            ends.append((parsed, field))
    if ends:
        end, field = min(ends)
        if on_date >= end:
            return "否：已终止", f"{field}={end.isoformat()}（终止当日不计）"
        return "是：日期支持", f"截至{end.isoformat()}前；终止字段{field}"
    if open_ended:
        return "是：日期支持（Until Canceled）", "未见取消/减损日；不代表永久或无条件有效"
    return "不确定：缺终止依据", "无到期/取消/减损日期，也非Until Canceled"


def is_supported(row, kind, on_date):

    return None

        return "适用范围未确认"
    supported = [(line, row) for line, row in rows if is_supported(row, "bond", on_date)]
    if not supported:
        return "否：无日期可支持记录"
    amounts = [money(row.get("bondamt")) for _, row in supported]
    amounts = [amount for amount in amounts if amount is not None]
    if not amounts:
        return "不确定：金额缺失/无法解析"
    if any(amount >= threshold for amount in amounts):
        return f"是：至少一笔达到通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}"

    return "否"

    gap_end = None
    while day <= HORIZON:
        if not any(is_supported(row, kind, day) for _, row in rows):
            if gap_start is None:

            gap_end = day
        elif gap_start is not None:
            break
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    if gap_start is None:
        return None
    triggering = []
    for line, row in rows:

def build(input_dir, output_dir):
    for filename in FILES.values():
        path = input_dir / filename
        if not path.is_file():

def verify(output_dir):
    expected = {"analysis.py", "audit.xlsx", "memo.docx", "results.json"}
    present = {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    missing = expected - present

    wb = load_workbook(output_dir / "audit.xlsx", read_only=True, data_only=True)

    if set(wb.sheetnames) != required_sheets:

    if wb["逐执照"].max_row != 1554 or wb["保证金记录"].max_row != 1725 or wb["保险记录"].max_row != 738:

    Document(output_dir / "memo.docx")

        parsed = json.load(handle)
    if parsed["metadata"]["as_of"] != AS_OF.isoformat():

def main():

    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    build(args.input, args.output)
    verify(args.output)
    print(f"Generated and verified audit.xlsx, memo.docx, results.json in {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def read_csv(path):
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle))


def parse_date(value):
    value = (value or "").strip()
    if not value or value == "Until Canceled":
        return None, "blank_or_open"
    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date(), "parsed"
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None, "unparseable"


def money(value):
    try:
        return Decimal(value)
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError):
        return None


def iso(value):
    return value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, date) else ""


def protection_state(row, kind, on_date):
    if kind == "bond":
        start_field = "bondeffectivedate"
        end_fields = ("bondexpirationdate", "bondcanceldate", "bondimpaireddate")
        open_ended = row.get("bondexpirationdate") == "Until Canceled"
    else:
        start_field = "effectivedate"
        end_fields = ("expirationdate", "canceldate")
        open_ended = False

    start, start_status = parse_date(row.get(start_field))
    bad = [field for field in (start_field,) + end_fields if row.get(field) and row.get(field) != "Until Canceled" and parse_date(row.get(field))[1] == "unparseable"]
    if bad:
        return "不确定：日期无法解析", "、".join(bad)
    if start_status != "parsed":
        return "不确定：缺生效日", start_field
    if on_date < start:
        return "否：尚未生效", f"生效日{start.isoformat()}"

    ends = []
    for field in end_fields:
        parsed, status = parse_date(row.get(field))
        if status == "parsed":
            ends.append((parsed, field))
    if ends:
        end, field = min(ends)
        if on_date >= end:
            return "否：已终止", f"{field}={end.isoformat()}（终止当日不计）"
        return "是：日期支持", f"截至{end.isoformat()}前；终止字段{field}"
    if open_ended:
        return "是：日期支持（Until Canceled）", "未见取消/减损日；不代表永久或无条件有效"
    return "不确定：缺终止依据", "无到期/取消/减损日期，也非Until Canceled"


def is_supported(row, kind, on_date):
    return protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0].startswith("是：")


def classify_scope(reg):
    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] == "CC":
        return "RCW 18.27直接筛查（仍须核验活动与豁免）"
    return "本包未确认适用；转相应专门许可制度核验"


def contractor_class(reg):
    if reg["contractorlicensetypecode"] != "CC":
        return "未确认"
    return "一般" if reg.get("specialtycode1") == "01" or reg.get("specialtycode1desc", "").upper() == "GENERAL" else "专业"


def usual_bond_threshold(reg):
    cls = contractor_class(reg)
    if cls == "一般":
        return Decimal("30000")
    if cls == "专业":
        return Decimal("15000")
    return None


def amount_support(reg, rows, on_date):
    threshold = usual_bond_threshold(reg)
    if threshold is None:
        return "适用范围未确认"
    supported = [(line, row) for line, row in rows if is_supported(row, "bond", on_date)]
    if not supported:
        return "否：无日期可支持记录"
    amounts = [money(row.get("bondamt")) for _, row in supported]
    amounts = [amount for amount in amounts if amount is not None]
    if not amounts:
        return "不确定：金额缺失/无法解析"
    if any(amount >= threshold for amount in amounts):
        return f"是：至少一笔达到通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}"
    return f"否：单笔均低于通常门槛${threshold:,.0f}（不叠加）"


def presence(rows, kind, on_date):
    states = [protection_state(row, kind, on_date)[0] for _, row in rows]
    if any(state.startswith("是：") for state in states):
        return "是"
    if any(state.startswith("不确定：") for state in states):
        return "不确定"
    return "否"


def insurance_form(rows, on_date):
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "否":
        return "证据不足：无日期可支持保险行；不等于未投保"
    if presence(rows, "insurance", on_date) == "不确定":
        return "不确定：日期字段不足，且单一insuranceamt不能证明法定形式"
    return "不足以证明：insuranceamt不含责任分项、除外责任、保单类型或替代账户信息"


def describe_rows(rows, kind):
    if not rows:
        return "无来源行"
    parts = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if kind == "bond":
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('bondeffectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('bondexpirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('bondcanceldate') or '空'}; 减损{row.get('bondimpaireddate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('bondamt') or '空'}"
            )
        else:
            parts.append(
                f"行{line}: 生效{row.get('effectivedate') or '空'}; 到期{row.get('expirationdate') or '空'}; "
                f"取消{row.get('canceldate') or '空'}; 金额{row.get('insuranceamt') or '空'}"
            )
    return " | ".join(parts)


def window_gap(rows, kind):
    if not any(is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) for _, row in rows):
        return None
    day = AS_OF + timedelta(days=1)
    gap_start = None
    gap_end = None
    while day <= HORIZON:
        if not any(is_supported(row, kind, day) for _, row in rows):
            if gap_start is None:
                gap_start = day
            gap_end = day
        elif gap_start is not None:
            break
        day += timedelta(days=1)
    if gap_start is None:
        return None
    triggering = []
    for line, row in rows:
        if is_supported(row, kind, AS_OF) and not is_supported(row, kind, gap_start):
            triggering.append(line)
    return {"start": gap_start, "end": gap_end, "trigger_lines": triggering}


def duplicate_groups(rows, keys):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for line, row in rows:
        groups[tuple(row.get(key, "") for key in keys)].append((line, row))
    return [(key, values) for key, values in groups.items() if len(values) > 1]


def set_cell_link(cell, target, text=None):

    cell.hyperlink = target
    cell.style = "Hyperlink"


def write_sheet(ws, headers, rows, widths=None, freeze="A2", autofilter=True):
    ws.append(headers)
    for row in rows:
        ws.append(row)
    fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
        cell.fill = fill
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    ws.freeze_panes = freeze
    if autofilter and ws.max_row >= 1:
        ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
    if widths:
        for index, width in enumerate(widths, 1):
            ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(index)].width = width
